name: Tanetsuke Dungeon ~Kasshoku Elf Sanran Acme~
original_name: 種付けダンジョン～褐色エルフ産卵アクメ～
source:
This is the deepest part of the dungeon.  
Here, the high elf Eleanor is held captive.  

One day, a dark elf woman arrives in the dungeon.  
She seems to be Eleanor’s acquaintance—and she’s here to rescue her.  
Eleanor trusts the dark elf’s abilities and boasts,  
“She’ll definitely save me… Alisson is a master of magic, the pride of our nation… You’re finished.”  

But then, an idea strikes.  
What if he shows Eleanor how he violates the dark elf? It’ll be fun to play with her like that.  
With that thought, Millennium puts his plan into motion…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012213.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
这里是地下城最深处。高等精灵埃莉诺被关押于此。

某天，一名黑暗精灵女子来到地下城。她似乎是埃莉诺的熟人，而且是来营救她的。埃莉诺相信黑暗精灵的能力，自信地说：

“她一定会救我……艾莉森是我国引以为傲的魔法大师……你完了。”

可是，米伦突然有了一个主意：如果让埃莉诺看看自己如何侵犯黑暗精灵，会不会很有趣？想到这里，米伦开始实施计划……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012213.html/]dlsite[/url]]
